$comment: A starting point for a New York night-lighting card, to be framed in the tuner (scripts/capture-scenes/tune.mjs): from 400 km over the Atlantic south-east of New York at the hero video's instant, looking back north-west at the lit coast, so the dark sea fills the bottom of the picture where a card's text goes. name: night-lights-orbit-new-york
description: From 400 km over the Atlantic south-east of New York at 23:10:58 UTC on 25 October 2026 (19:10:58 EDT, the hero video's instant), looking north-west at the lit coast from Washington to Boston, with the dark sea below.
